dashboard_elements.title: Wildfire News Traffic Breakdown for Individual Incidents

dashboard_elements.body_text:
This report is in beta, so applying the filters is a bit clunky. 


To pull the reports for an individual incident, change the "**Page URL**" filter to:

Change filter type to "**Contains**". (the default is "**Is**", click on that to change it.)

and put the value as "incidentNumber=CNNNNN". 

Where "CNNNNN" is the incident number. The easiest way to do this will be to take the incident number from the incident page. 


**NOTE:** Filters are case-sensitive. 

If no filter is applied the report will give overall counts for all incidents under "https://wildfiresituation.nrs.gov.bc.ca/incidents".
